knownDefects.preventionEvidence: The exact independently admitted still is preserved; decoded start, middle and end frames are inspected for style and identity drift.
No new location pixels are generated; the admitted season wardrobe and bounded exit remain unchanged.
No object pixels move or regenerate; hanger, rail, shelf and footwear relationships remain identical to the admitted still.
No anatomy is generated or transformed; the front-facing Heroine remains pixel-stable throughout.
The only visible words are exact editable Canva text checked character-for-character in the decoded end frame.
Every required outfit is bound in the admitted source and inspected at full resolution; no new prop or garment is generated.
CapCut is instructed to use exact Canva source time [0.000, 8.200); the remaining second is a labelled editing handle, not programme runtime.
The only motion performs the named threshold-label job; no decorative motion is added.
The candidate is explicitly a deterministic transition graphic, not misrepresented as character animation.
The title reveal is a directional one-shot and is not represented or repeated as a loop.

The exact MP4 is browser-decoded at 1920 by 1080 and representative start, pre-title, wipe, readable-title, assembly-out and source-end frames are checksum-bound; the earlier white-tail export was rejected.
